p3c-baseline.description: Anchor hypothesis: median site-vs-neighbour residual above 50 ADU marks an anomaly; residual std above 25 ADU marks VARIABLE vs STABLE; neighbourhood stable when the residual exceeds 10x the local scale; persistence requires signal in >= 2 independent groups.

conflict_sign_changes.rationale: >=2 strict sign crossings => genuine contradictory evidence

local_anomaly_adu.rationale: above read-noise |residual| (~4-5 ADU), below the weak-anomaly band (~60 ADU)

min_frames.rationale: minimum non-censored frames before a residual may be characterised

neighbourhood_snr.rationale: between sensor-site snr (>=~18) and confounder snr (~3.3-4.2)

stable_disp_adu.rationale: between stable classes' std (~4-5 ADU) and variable classes' std (>=~150 ADU)

transient_fraction.rationale: between single-frame-transient duty (~0.17) and intermittent duty (~0.5)

p3c-conservative.description: Higher presence bar: only residuals above 150 ADU count as anomalies, so the weak-anomaly band (~60 ADU) is treated as no-anomaly (NONE). Otherwise identical to baseline.

conflict_sign_changes.rationale: >=2 strict sign crossings => genuine contradictory evidence

local_anomaly_adu.rationale: above the weak-anomaly band (~60 ADU), below hot-pixel scale (~1500 ADU)

min_frames.rationale: minimum non-censored frames before a residual may be characterised

neighbourhood_snr.rationale: between sensor-site snr (>=~18) and confounder snr (~3.3-4.2)

stable_disp_adu.rationale: between stable classes' std (~4-5 ADU) and variable classes' std (>=~150 ADU)

transient_fraction.rationale: between single-frame-transient duty (~0.17) and intermittent duty (~0.5)

p3c-sensitive.description: Lower presence bar and looser local-vs-global and conflict thresholds: anomalies above 25 ADU count, neighbourhood stable above 6x local scale, a single sign crossing is already conflicting. Catches more, abstains less.

conflict_sign_changes.rationale: a single strict sign crossing is already treated as conflicting

local_anomaly_adu.rationale: well above read-noise |residual| (~4-5 ADU); detects the weak-anomaly band (~60 ADU)

min_frames.rationale: minimum non-censored frames before a residual may be characterised

neighbourhood_snr.rationale: still above confounder snr (~3.3-4.2), below sensor-site snr (>=~18)

stable_disp_adu.rationale: between stable classes' std (~4-5 ADU) and variable classes' std (>=~150 ADU)

transient_fraction.rationale: splits intermittent duty (~0.5) from single-frame-transient duty (~0.17)

corpus.size_justification: 20 classes x 5 seeds; 2 epochs x 2 independent groups x 6 light frames manifest rare-state (ordinal 5), transient (ordinal 3), star-crossing and sign-changing behaviours while staying fast.

censored_count.description: number of frames whose value hit the declared hard limit

cross_epoch_recurrence.description: recurrence of epoch median signatures across epochs

cross_group_recurrence.description: recurrence of group median signatures across independent groups

local_residual_median.description: median |site - median(same-CFA neighbours)| over light frames

local_residual_peak.description: max |site - median(same-CFA neighbours)| over light frames

post_cal_median.description: median |value - representative dark| (NaN when no dark reference)

residual_iqr.description: interquartile range of the canonical residual series

residual_span.description: max - min of the canonical residual series

residual_std.description: population std of the canonical residual series

robust_local_scale_median.description: median raw MAD of the same-CFA local window

sign_changes.description: strict sign crossings of the canonical residual
